newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: China CNPC wins Venezuela Intercampo oil contract.
newsitem.headline: China CNPC wins Venezuela Intercampo oil contract.

text.p: China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) agreed Tuesday to pay $118 million for the contract to operate Venezuela's Intercampo oil field, state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) said.
Three other consortia bidded for the field, on the second day of Venezuela's third round of operating licenses.
A total of 131 companies are competing for 20 contracts and the winners are determined purely by the size of their cash bids.
Under the 20-year contract, the operator will produce hydrocarbons on behalf of PDVSA subsidiary Lagoven in exchange for a fee worked out on a sliding scale.

Intercampo was discovered in eastern Venezuela in 1957. As a condition of the contract, the operator must invest at least $24 million within three years, although PDVSA expects investment to be higher.
